description: This file contains extension methods for IServiceCollection to configure and add Azure Table Storage-based reminders in an Orleans application. It provides multiple overloads of the UseAzureTableReminderService method to facilitate different configuration scenarios, including direct options, options builder, and connection string. The methods set up dependencies such as IReminderTable and configure options accordingly.

classes.name: AzureStorageReminderServiceCollectionExtensions
classes.description: Static class providing extension methods to add Azure Table Storage reminders to an IServiceCollection.

methods.name: UseAzureTableReminderService
methods.description: Configures and adds Azure Table Storage reminder service with direct options configuration.

methods.description: Configures and adds Azure Table Storage reminder service with options builder configuration.
